subject: Proposal: one-time SLO amelioration credit for Storwell
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@storwell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Higher-than-expected latency impacting inference pipeline

Hi Marissa,

We saw an extended period of elevated p99 latency across our inference traffic from 11/13 02:00 UTC to 11/14 18:00 UTC. Our engineers compiled a latency report (attached) showing sustained tail latency spikes that caused timeout retries in our ingestion pipeline. This materially impacted two customer demos and a batch scoring job — estimated revenue exposure of ~$90k for this quarter.

Per our contract (SLO: 99.95% monthly uptime) we wanted to start the conversation about making Storwell whole. Given the impact, we're asking Redwood for a one-time remediation allowance: either (A) a credit equal to two months of service or (B) a custom credit that more accurately offsets the recorded loss (we estimated $85k). We're open to a joint postmortem and an agreed remediation plan.

I attached the latency export and the relevant SLO excerpt we pulled from the portal. Happy to jump on a call today if helpful.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Head of Platform Engineering
Storwell

Attachments: storwell_latency_report.pdf, SLO-extract-Prod-2026.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@storwell.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Higher-than-expected latency impacting inference pipeline

Alex — thanks for the clear summary and the attached report. I'm really sorry Storwell was impacted; this is the last thing we want for customers running demos.

I've reviewed the latency export at a glance and have looped in Karthik (accounts) and Vanessa (enterprise ops) to scope an appropriate concession. We take SLO misses seriously and typically evaluate: magnitude of impact, contract value, and remediation commitments.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- Internal review (ops + product) to confirm incident window and attribution (today).
- Marissa to propose a one-time amelioration allowance for exec approval (within 48 hours).
- If approved, we’ll document the credit in an MSA amendment and schedule a joint postmortem call.

Can you confirm the dollar exposure estimate you referenced? Also confirm whether Storwell would accept a blended offer (credit + one free month) in lieu of a straight credit.

I can put together a recommendation for exec approval by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0191

Marissa — quick internal note. Finance thresholds and precedent: we typically greenlight up to $25k in account-level credits without exec sign-off for this tier. Above that we need either VP or CRO approval and a one-off concession rationale memo.

Storwell is a mid-enterprise renewal opportunity (ARR ~ $680k) and long-standing reference customer — we should balance retention risk against precedent. Options I’d support for the exec ask:
- Standard: one month free (fast, low touch) — likely not sufficient given Alex's $85k estimate.
- Middle ground: $40k cash-equivalent credit + one month free, plus a committed joint postmortem and operational playbook.
- Aggressive: custom credit ~ $75k (exec approval required) if they commit to 12-month renewal and elevated partnership (co-marketing).

I’ve attached a quick pricing_workup_internal.xlsx that models impact to Q4 and FY. If Marissa wants to pursue the aggressive option, we need a short memo (1‑pager) and Vanessa’s sign-off.

—Karthik
Head of Account Strategy

Attachments: pricing_workup_internal.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Exec approval request: Storwell concession proposal (decision by 11/20)

Vanessa — forwarding the Storwell ask and internal framing. Summary below for quick decision:

Summary of impact
- Incident window: 2026-11-13 02:00 UTC to 2026-11-14 18:00 UTC
- Customer estimate of revenue exposure: ~$85k
- Contract SLO: 99.95% monthly uptime
- Relationship: renewal opportunity (deal SW-45321), ARR ~ $680k, reference customer

My recommended offer for approval
Option A (preferred): $40,000 credit + one free month of service, conditional on Storwell signing a 12-month renewal amendment at current rate and participating in a joint postmortem and action plan.
Option B (escalation if they push): $75,000 custom credit (exec approval required) + joint postmortem and 12-month renewal commitment; requires Finance and CRO sign-off.

Requested decision: please approve Option A or authorize escalation to Option B by EOD Friday 2026-11-20. If approved, I will:
- Draft MSA amendment language and DocuSign envelope
- Coordinate postmortem and schedule remediation checkpoint
- Update HubSpot (deal SW-45321) with concession details

Quoted earlier emails are below for context.

Thanks — I’ll be standing by to finalize language.

Best,
Marissa Cole
